descriptionChirho: To remain silent or speechless, refraining from speech or sound (Qal intransitive).
To stop moving, halt, or cease activity; physical stillness or cessation of motion (Qal with spatial/physical sense).
To be forcibly silenced, cut off, or destroyed; passive cessation implying annihilation or doom (Nifal passive and Qal cohortative with destructive connotation).
To cause someone or something to become quiet or calm; causative silencing without destructive intent (Piel intensive-causative).
To bring to silence by destroying or annihilating; causative destruction that results in permanent silence (Hifil causative).
